test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The wedding planner is making all the reservations and arrangements in advance. **

options.text: All the reservations and arrangements are to be made by the wedding planner in advance.
All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance.
All the reservations and arrangements are being making by the wedding planner in advance.
All the reservations and arrangements are made by the wedding planner in advance.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object in the active sentence.
 
 
• **Subject**: The wedding planner
 
• **Verb**: is making
 
• **Object**: all the reservations and arrangements in advance
 
 
 
• Move the object of the active sentence to the beginning of the passive sentence.
 
• Object (from the active sentence): all the reservations and arrangements in advance
 
• Use the appropriate form of the auxiliary verb "**to be**" (in this case, "are being") based on the tense of the active verb ("**is making**").
 
• Add the past participle form of the active verb ("**made**").
 
• Include the agent (the doer of the action), which is "by the wedding planner."
 
• Following these rules, we transform the sentence into passive voice: "*All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance.*"

Thus,** option 2** is the correct answer.
